text: As the BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-16: Speed, planning first, and initiatives in parallel' asks: make planning come first. Every request is fleshed out in planning (goal, which rung of the ladder it serves, acceptance, open questions, dependencies, what it touches) before design or code, and open initiatives are planned together into one coordinated plan that says which can run in parallel and in what order, instead of working the queue one at a time oldest first. This covers the queued item 20261016-005949-n2qb (gaps audit and refine the planning pipeline) and 20261016-035330-vs76 (queue order and stopping a drain). Design work, starting with moving compute to CI with intelligent routing, comes after this lands.
